unit: public debt with no public register
what: Kenya's total public debt without a single publicly accessible register listing lenders, terms, and projects.
why: We pay foreign loans via PAYE and fuel levies without knowing the terms.
check: Read the National Assembly Public Debt Committee Report on parliament.go.ke.
message: Kenya owes over Sh10.5 trillion in public debt, yet Parliament is only now pushing for an open register.
action: Track your taxes: read the Public Debt Committee report on parliament.go.ke
source: National Assembly Public Debt and Privatisation Committee Report, October 2026; Central Bank of Kenya Public Debt Statistical Bulletin
caption:
Kenya owes Sh10.5 trillion, but ordinary taxpayers cannot look up who was paid what. Now Parliament admits we need an open debt register. We pay the bills; show us the books.
